investigation_notes.Description: PowerShell was executed on WKSTN-FIN-04 via a process chain starting with winword.exe (parent outlook.exe) under user j_smith. The script opens a TCP connection to 45.33.19.121:443 and decodes+executes payload in memory, which is consistent with remote command and control techniques. Hash reputation for the initiating process is clean and the external IP has no notable history, but the active outbound connection from a trusted app to an external host raises high-risk concerns and merits escalation.
